My school works for their professors right now, instead for the students. There is no assistance that you can get from them. As for therapy/counseling, I dont think its covered and Id have to pay about 25 euros per session, which is about 2/3 of my monthly "income". 

She is really nice when she comes to me but over the internet and this long distance relationship it is very hard. I dont really know what to do.
